languageSecurityMappings.mapping: Operation options are typed camelCase; live-model neutral snake_case spellings remain separately documented. Never route destructive text setters through preserving text.replace.
Exact JavaScript strings; no implicit coercion, regex, normalization, host locale or malformed surrogate splitting. Combining sequences are preserved literally, not canonically equated.

Only admitted bytes or capability-scoped VFS input; async admission/publication. XML mutation stays within owned package nodes. No ambient filesystem, network, native runtime, font discovery, arbitrary evaluation or host identity.

CLI ordinals are one-based; SDK selection follows explicit selector types. Require exactly one first/all/occurrence, report zero matches unless allowEmpty, and retain common error/envelope/publication rules.

The byte operation returns a new byte snapshot and containing locations, not live Run/Paragraph collections. Separate live ownership, mutation invalidation, iteration and accessors remain required; existing extraction evidence is not erased.

replacePresentationText(input: BinaryInput, options: ReplacePresentationTextOptions, context: SelectionContext): Promise<TextReplacementResult>; options.style?: { bold?: boolean; italic?: boolean }. CLI --style-json uses identical typed keys. Missing properties inherit; explicit false disables; unknown fields fail; changes affect inserted spans only. A supplied override must contain at least one supported property.

Package-internal XmlPart gains setText(element, text) and markup(element, standalone?: boolean). The package export map and index do not expose XmlPart. These bounded owned-node helpers support text/style edits and namespace-complete reuse; they do not implement the public live-model .element/.part API or expose arbitrary XPath, method dispatch or host access.
